name: Mont Rochelle Hotel
positioning: Hotel at the centre of the Mont Rochelle wine estate in Franschhoek, at the foot of the Klein Dassenberg Mountain Range in the Cape Winelands
best_for: Wine lovers who want to stay on a working wine estate with daily tastings
Couples wanting a suite with a private terrace and plunge pool among the vineyards
Families or groups who want a private villa with its own pools

facts.text: Mont Rochelle is a hotel and vineyard in Franschhoek at the foot of the Klein Dassenberg Mountain Range.
The hotel sits at the centre of the Mont Rochelle wine estate in the Cape Winelands.
Mont Rochelle is a 45-minute drive from Cape Town.
Mont Rochelle is within 35 minutes of the Stellenbosch, Paarl and Somerset West wine routes.
Room types include Shiraz and Merlot Rooms and Pinotage Suites.
The Mont Rochelle Spa has two treatment rooms and a hammam.
MIKO is the signature restaurant, with 180-degree views of the Franschhoek Valley.
Wine tastings are an everyday occurrence at Mont Rochelle.
Guests can go hiking and mountain biking.
Guests can enjoy lawn games and tennis and stroll the vineyards.
The Manor House is a private four-bedroom villa about a 10-minute walk from the main hotel building.
The Manor House has two private heated pools and a personal gym.

highlights.text: The Cap Classique Vineyard Pool Suites have private terraces and plunge pools.
The winery dates from the 1850s and was once a fruit packing shed.
Because of the winery's National Heritage status, all of its white wine tanks are horizontal.
Guests can take in panoramic views of the Dassenberg Mountains from the pool.
The Winemaker's Dinner includes a guided tour of the historic cellar with winemaker Michael Langenhoven, followed by a five-course pairing dinner.

considerations.text: Mont Rochelle is in the Cape Winelands, a 45-minute drive from Cape Town, rather than in the city.
The spa is intimate, with two treatment rooms and a hammam.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
